about: The LOD configuration each district's LIVE v4 build used, recovered 28 Sep 2026 from the build log that wrote its current sky_<slug>_v4_0.glb. Any rebuild that means to reproduce the live product - in particular the v5 local-frame re-export - must use these, not a blanket LOD 3. Districts not listed here are uniform LOD 3. A two-tier district has an LOD 2 base, with buildings at or above tall_h at tall_lod.
why: On 28 Sep a v5 rebuild of alkhairanfirst at uniform LOD 3 came out 6.1% off the live tile. The live tile was a two-tier build (LOD 2 base, >= 60 m at LOD 3) from lod2t60_alkhairanfirst.log, not the uniform LOD 3 build logged five hours earlier. A building-count gate passed it anyway: same buildings, different product.

dubaiindustrialcity.source: uniform LOD 2 - its live v4 build chose LOD 2
